'''Gantry AB14''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|landing pad]] complex located at the [[Trellik Hive]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], near [[Gantry AA7]]. The ''[[Krayt Fang]]'' once landed there during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="LongArm" />
